newsArray.title: India's Hockey Team Secures Historic Gold at Asian Games 2026
newsArray.description: The Indian men's hockey team has made history by winning the gold medal at the 2026 Asian Games, defeating Malaysia 5-1 in the final. This victory not only secures back-to-back gold medals but also marks India's fifth gold in men's hockey at the Asian Games. Manpreet Singh's mother expressed her joy and relief after the match, highlighting the team's unity and performance. With this win, India has also qualified for the 2028 LA Olympics, making it a significant milestone in Indian sports history.
